description: How a host's MCP tools are named, for its heads to show (mcp__<server>__<tool> as "Server / Tool"): what its MCP servers and their tools say they're called, and the names its claude says its servers are configured as.

servers.description: Each server's title, by its name as it's put in its tools' names (each character not a letter, digit, _ or - made _): mesh: Mesh, claude_ai_Slack: Slack.

tools.description: A tool's title, by its whole name, where its server gives one (mcp__emission__javascript_tool: Run JavaScript).
